what: Plan adds SUMMARY_OUTCOME=cancelled-assessor-worse only to SKILL.md prose, but render-final-summary.sh rejects outcomes outside its hardcoded case list
scenario_or_breakage: When the operator chooses Stop after a WORSE assessor verdict, the Final summary block calls render-final-summary.sh --outcome cancelled-assessor-worse and exits 2 instead of rendering the cancellation summary
suggested_fix: Update render-final-summary.sh to include cancelled-assessor-worse, and add a focused test for that outcome

what: Plan increments the round cursor only for Gate C(c), but existing Gate A post-plan re-entry from Gate B(c) or Gate C(b) also launches a fresh Step 3 and may revise plan.txt
scenario_or_breakage: After Discuss further or Switch to discussion mode, Ready for review re-enters Step 3 with the old cursor, so plan-review artifacts reuse the prior round and the round >= 2 assessor may never fire
suggested_fix: Increment the HARD round cursor on every post-plan Ready-for-review path that re-enters Step 3, not just Gate C(c), or explicitly centralize round advancement in the Step 3 re-entry prelude

what: assess-plan-round.sh has no feature-file argv or documented default, while dispatch-plan-assessors.sh requires --feature-file PATH
scenario_or_breakage: Implementers following the plan will either fail dispatcher argv validation or invent inconsistent feature context handling, causing assessor dispatch to fail open every round
suggested_fix: Add --feature-file to assess-plan-round.sh and the SKILL.md call, or mirror plan-review-loop.sh by defaulting to ${IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR:-$DESIGN_TMPDIR}/feature-description.txt and failing open with a Warning when missing

what: Plan specifies predictable .tmp.<pid> copy targets for atomic snapshot writes
scenario_or_breakage: A preexisting symlink or colliding temp path inside a preserved DESIGN_TMPDIR can make cp -p write through the temp path before mv, weakening the snapshot helper's file-containment guarantees
suggested_fix: Use mktemp in DESIGN_TMPDIR for temp files, refuse symlink temp/final paths, and clean up temp files with a trap before mv
